answer: Coordination-Delta Levy: each action batch joins a shared scheduler that computes its marginal coordination delta—the added pairwise action correlation and resource contention it creates among concurrent agents. Dense, synchronized sybil batches raise delta superlinearly. Each batch pays delta × congestion price into an oasis reserve; a cedar-seeded audit lottery selects batches for cross-checking. Attackers must fund every sybil identity’s repeated levy and absorb correlated audit hits, so mass coordination costs far more than diverse honest activity.
